The father of Sigmund Freud—*Jacob Kolloman (or Kalman) Freud*—worked as a **wool merchant** (often described as a wool trader or wool draper). He earned his living by buying, selling and dealing in wool and textiles.  

**Source**: Wikipedia, *Jacob Freud* – “He mainly earned his living as a wool merchant.”
